_about: Batch B3 (model split + execution). Owner: B3 writer. Search other glossary files before adding a term.

remote-experts.short: A parameter-free MoE shell on the attention role. It keeps the native MoE forward but sends the expert compute to the FFN role.
remote-experts.long: On CUDA, every MoE layer on the attention side builds AFDDeepseekV2RemoteExpertsMoE, a native DeepseekV2MoE with its experts replaced by a proxy ({{cite afd_plugin/model_executor/models/deepseek_v2.py:277-335}}).

afd-forward-metadata.short: A sidecar object that AFD attaches to the vLLM forward context. It holds the connector, the stage index and count, the transaction id, and the token offsets and lengths.
afd-forward-metadata.long: Model wrappers read it with get_afd_metadata_from_forward_context; the runner installs it as vLLM makes each forward context ({{cite afd_plugin/model_executor/models/forward_context.py:18-67}}).

afd-balanced.short: A deterministic, EP-balanced MoE routing strategy for benchmarks. It returns uniform weights and fixed expert ids, so it changes model outputs.
afd-balanced.long: Opt in with vLLM's VLLM_MOE_ROUTING_SIMULATION_STRATEGY ({{cite afd_plugin/model_executor/routing_simulator.py:122-171}}). It is for benchmark and profiling runs only.
